mapper.select: select distinct m.* from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.id inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id inner join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0 and m.status = 1 and m.deleted = 0 and m.menu_type in (0, 1) order by m.parent_id asc, m.sort asc, m.id asc
